_comment: ngsolve linear_elasticity#1 (body-force CoefficientFunction must match the vector space's shape). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh 0.3 and unit_cube maxh 0.6, VectorH1 order 1. The correctly shaped source assembles to a non-zero load vector, and the rule really is 'match the space' -- a 3-tuple is the mismatch in 2D and the correct one in 3D, with the 2-tuple swapping roles. THREE CORRECTIONS to the Signal. (a) The failure point: both mismatches raise from LinearForm.__iadd__, never reaching .Assemble(), so a guard wrapped around Assemble as the Signal instructs sees neither. (b) The claim's OWN example, a scalar fx on a vector space, produces no dimension message at all -- the product is vector-valued and NGSolve says 'SymbolicLFI needs scalar-valued CoefficientFunction', the same string mhd#7 is about, so grepping for a dimension mismatch on the claim's own example finds nothing. (c) The 3-component case does give a dimension message but the literal text is "Dimensions don't match, op = * dims1 = 0: 3, dims2 = 0: 2" -- contracted, not the claim's 'dimensions do not match', so a substring guard written from the claim misses it. Mutation: passing the correct 2-tuple in the scalar branch removes that exception and the fixture fails on scalar_gives_the_symboliclfi_message.
